concept.title: Free or subsidised activities for children
concept.shortdesc: As a parent on a tight budget, I need to know which children's activities are free or subsidised, so that my children can take part without straining the household budget.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-008). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: Cost decides what is possible; wants to know about council and leisure-trust schemes.
A good result: Activities marked free or reduced-price, with who qualifies and how to apply.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.

ul.li: subsidised swimming or gym for children
cheap clubs for children near me
council scheme for free kids sport

section.title: Categories that should answer it
section.p: No category yet answers this need. That is a finding: the discovered categories do not cover it.
